full_judgment:
A M Mahmudur Rahman, J: This petition for leave to appeal by the defendant-petitioners is from the judgment and order, dated 12.11.92 of the High Court Division passed in F.A. No. 233 of 1981 dismissing the appeal and thereby upholding the judgment and decree of the trial court. 

 4. The trial court, on contest, decreed the suit for specific performance of contract by its judgment and decree dated 29.6.1981. On appeal by defendant Nos. 2 and 4 the High Court Division dismissed the appeal and affirmed the judgment and decree of the trial court on the finding that the plaintiffs proved the execution of bainapatra, Ext. 1 with the defendant Nos. 1 and 2 and that the agreement was followed by a demand for execution and registration of the kabala and that the bainapatra, Ext.1 was obtainted with fraud and that the plaintiffs proved execution of Ext. 1 and that the bainapatra Ext. C(1) executed on 5.1.1984 on a blank paper was registered at Feni sub-registration Office on 27.4.1974. 

 5. Mr. Md. Aftab Hosain, learned Advocate-on-Record for the petitioner submits that as the plaintiffs failed to prove to perform their part under contract the courts below were wrong to decree the suit and that the courts below fell in error in holding that time is not essence of contract contrary to the terms of Ext. 1 and that although relief for specific performance of contract is a discretionary one but the courts below decreed the suit without considering the hardship of the defendants.
